config.name: force_census
config._purpose: EXPLORATORY (TASKS T13 rung 3, after O22). Price a point defect and the gap between the two orders at several sizes. A local defect costs the same at every size and can carry no long-range force; a boundary between two orders pays a fixed price per point it sweeps, which is a force that does not fall off at all.
config._prediction_written_before_the_run: The point defect costs the same at every size (local, so O22 applies to it). The gap per point is exactly 4(lambda - 1) at every size, so the force on a boundary between the two orders is constant with separation.
